{
  "name": "dsh-better-sidebar",
  "version": "0.34.0-alpha.0",
  "description": "Better Sidebar for DSH — file tree, editor, changes, tasks and side chat in one column, separate for every conversation. Configure it in Settings → Side card (bottom-left). Also exposes a service other plugins use to register sidebar tabs and file viewers.",
  "type": "module",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar"
  },
  "publishConfig": {
    "access": "public"
  },
  "main": "lib/index.js",
  "types": "lib/types/index.d.ts",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "types": "./lib/types/index.d.ts",
      "default": "./lib/index.js"
    },
    "./client": {
      "types": "./lib/types/client/index.d.ts",
      "default": "./lib/client.js"
    },
    "./client/service": {
      "types": "./lib/types/client/service.d.ts",
      "default": "./lib/client.js"
    },
    "./clues": {
      "types": "./lib/types/clues/index.d.ts",
      "default": "./lib/clues.js"
    },
    "./client/api": {
      "types": "./lib/types/client/service.d.ts",
      "default": "./lib/client.js"
    },
    "./src/*": "./src/*",
    "./icon": "./icon.svg",
    "./package.json": "./package.json",
    "./locale/*.json": "./locale/*.json"
  },
  "engines": {
    "dsh": ">=0.2.3-alpha.2 <0.3.0",
    "node": ">=20"
  },
  "packageManager": "pnpm@11.8.0",
  "dsh": {
    "bundle": {
      "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml"
    },
    "client": {
      "inject": [
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules"
      ],
      "platform": "web"
    },
    "manifestVersion": 1
  },
  "files": [
    "lib/index.js",
    "lib/client.js",
    "lib/client-registry.js",
    "lib/client-editor.js",
    "lib/client-locale.js",
    "lib/client-mermaid.js",
    "lib/client-terminal.js",
    "lib/clues.js",
    "lib/types/**/*.d.ts",
    "src",
    "scripts/check-profile-host-tree.mjs",
    "scripts/install.sh",
    "scripts/install.ps1",
    "cordis.patch.yml",
    "detail",
    "README.md",
    "README_ZH.md",
    "LICENSE",
    "icon.svg",
    "locale/*.json"
  ],
  "scripts": {
    "build": "node scripts/build-mermaid-frame-asset.mjs && node -e \"require('node:fs').rmSync('lib',{recursive:true,force:true})\" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsdown",
    "build:asset": "node scripts/build-mermaid-frame-asset.mjs",
    "prepublishOnly": "pnpm build",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "bundle": "node scripts/build-mermaid-frame-asset.mjs && tsdown",
    "watch": "node scripts/build-mermaid-frame-asset.mjs && tsdown --watch",
    "prepare": "node scripts/build-mermaid-frame-asset.mjs && tsdown",
    "test": "vitest run",
    "test:windows": "vitest run --maxWorkers=1",
    "test:mount": "bash scripts/e2e-mount.sh",
    "test:mount:aggregate": "bash scripts/e2e-aggregate-mount.sh",
    "clean": "node -e \"require('node:fs').rmSync('lib',{recursive:true,force:true})\"",
    "check:consumer-types": "bash scripts/check-consumer-types.sh",
    "check:engines": "node --experimental-strip-types scripts/win-engine-check.mjs --assert",
    "lint": "eslint ."
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "peerDependencies": {
    "@deepseek-ai/cordis": "^4.2.0-alpha.1",
    "@deepseek-ai/schemastery": ">=3.20.0-alpha.1 <4",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent": "^0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale": "^0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation": "^0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-input-trigger": "^0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives": "^0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings": "^0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right": "^0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots": "^0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webserver": "^0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm": "^0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-session": "^0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings": "^0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent": "^0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools": "^0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "react": "^18.2.0",
    "react-dom": "^18.2.0"
  },
  "peerDependenciesMeta": {
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right": {
      "optional": true
    }
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "ws": "^8.18.0",
    "yaml": "^2.9.1"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@codemirror/commands": "^6.10.4",
    "@codemirror/lang-cpp": "^6.0.3",
    "@codemirror/lang-css": "^6.3.1",
    "@codemirror/lang-go": "^6.0.1",
    "@codemirror/lang-html": "^6.4.12",
    "@codemirror/lang-java": "^6.0.2",
    "@codemirror/lang-javascript": "^6.2.5",
    "@codemirror/lang-json": "^6.0.2",
    "@codemirror/lang-markdown": "^6.5.2",
    "@codemirror/lang-php": "^6.0.2",
    "@codemirror/lang-python": "^6.2.1",
    "@codemirror/lang-rust": "^6.0.2",
    "@codemirror/lang-sql": "^6.10.0",
    "@codemirror/lang-vue": "^0.1.3",
    "@codemirror/lang-xml": "^6.1.0",
    "@codemirror/lang-yaml": "^6.1.3",
    "@codemirror/language": "^6.12.4",
    "@codemirror/legacy-modes": "^6.5.3",
    "@codemirror/search": "^6.7.1",
    "@codemirror/state": "^6.7.1",
    "@codemirror/view": "^6.43.8",
    "@cordisjs/plugin-loader": "^1.0.0-rc.5",
    "@deepseek-ai/cordis": "4.2.0-alpha.1",
    "@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-group": "~1.2.0-alpha.1",
    "@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-include": "1.2.0-alpha.1",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent": "0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop": "0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-attachment": "0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale": "0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store": "0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation": "0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-input-trigger": "0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives": "0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings": "0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right": "0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots": "0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-error": "0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webserver": "0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm": "0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-ptc-runtime": "0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox": "0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-policy": "0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope": "0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-session": "0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence": "0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-projection": "0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings": "0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent": "0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt": "0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools": "0.2.3-alpha.2",

    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-util-code-language": "0.2.3-alpha.2",

    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-util-workspace-path": "0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-working-directory": "0.2.3-alpha.2",
    "@eslint/js": "^10.0.1",

  },
  "icon": "./icon.svg"
